rules.statement: Where a person has obtained possession of property subject to a trust or condition and fraudulently claims to hold it free from such trust or condition, they cannot be allowed the advantage of the Statute of Frauds.
rules.supporting_quote: It has been established by a chain of authorities, which cannot now be C.J. disputed, both in England and in this country, that where a person has obtained possession of a property of another, subject to a trust or condition, and fraudulently claims to hold it free from such trust or condition, he cannot be allowed to claim the advantage of the Statute of Frauds.
